description: A Perl script for downloading files with support for multiple mirrors, checksum verification, and different download tools.

methods.name: localmirrors
methods.description: Collects local mirror URLs from configuration files and environment variables.

methods.name: which
methods.description: Checks if a program is available in the system PATH.

methods.name: hash_cmd
methods.description: Determines the appropriate hash command based on the checksum length.

methods.name: tool_present
methods.description: Checks if a specific download tool (curl, wget, aria2c) is available.

methods.name: select_tool
methods.description: Selects the download tool to use based on availability and environment variables.

methods.name: download_cmd
methods.description: Constructs the command line for downloading files using the selected tool.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Performs the file download from a mirror, with checksum verification.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes temporary files related to the download process.
